description: An order embedding of a finite subset extends to include any prescribed point if its target is nonempty, dense, and without endpoints.
signature:
Order.exists_orderEmbedding_insert.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β]
  [DenselyOrdered β] [NoMinOrder β] [NoMaxOrder β] [nonem : Nonempty β] (S : Finset α) (f : ↥S ↪o β) (a : α) :
  ∃ g, ⇑g ∘ Set.inclusion ⋯ = ⇑f
